ROUTER DNS ROUTING
Some of the router's own lookups go through a tunnel: the lines tagged with one.
read 04:09:30

== YOUR DEVICES' LOOKUPS ==
wgc1:pia-aus_perth → 9.9.9.9 [wgc1:pia-aus_perth, which is down] - TABLET
Everything else → dnsmasq → stubby → 1.1.1.2, 1.0.0.2 [Internet / wgc1:pia-aus_perth, which is down, encrypted (DoT)] - DNS-over-TLS

== THE ROUTER'S OWN LOOKUPS ==
1.1.1.2 [Internet, not encrypted] - DNS Server setting, ordinary DNS
1.0.0.2 [wgc1:pia-aus_perth, which is down] - DNS Server setting, ordinary DNS
127.0.1.1 stubby [Internet / wgc1:pia-aus_perth, which is down, encrypted (DoT)] - to 1.1.1.2 and 1.0.0.2, only if both of the above fail

== THE WATCHDOGS' LOOKUPS ==
wgc1:pia-aus_perth [Internet, encrypted (DoH)] - freedns.controld.com (76.76.2.1)
wgc2:pia-au_adelaide-pf [Internet, encrypted (DoH)] - freedns.controld.com (76.76.2.1)
wgc3:pia-au_brisbane-pf [Internet, encrypted (DoH)] - security.cloudflare-dns.com (1.1.1.2)
wgc4 [not configured]
wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne [Internet, encrypted (DoH)] - freedns.controld.com (76.76.2.1)

== THE SLOTS' DNS SERVERS ==
9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112 [shared by 4] - used by wgc1:pia-aus_perth, wgc2:pia-au_adelaide-pf, wgc3:pia-au_brisbane-pf and wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne. Rules 1016 and 1017 send the router's own lookups to them through wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne.

== EVIDENCE ==

DNS routing rules (ip rule, iif lo)
Which tunnel carries the router's own lookups to each address. The lowest rule number wins.
1016:   from all to 9.9.9.9 iif lo lookup 5  # wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne
1017:   from all to 149.112.112.112 iif lo lookup 5  # wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne
1022:   from all to 9.9.9.9 iif lo lookup 7  # wgc3:pia-au_brisbane-pf
1023:   from all to 149.112.112.112 iif lo lookup 7  # wgc3:pia-au_brisbane-pf
1025:   from all to 9.9.9.9 iif lo lookup 8  # wgc2:pia-au_adelaide-pf
1026:   from all to 149.112.112.112 iif lo lookup 8  # wgc2:pia-au_adelaide-pf
1028:   from all to 9.9.9.9 iif lo lookup 9  # wgc1:pia-aus_perth
1029:   from all to 149.112.112.112 iif lo lookup 9  # wgc1:pia-aus_perth

DNS redirects (VPN_FUSION)
Pinned devices' lookups to the router, sent on to their slot's first DNS server.
-N VPN_FUSION
-A VPN_FUSION -s 192.168.1.55/32 -d 192.168.1.254/32 -p udp -m udp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to-destination 9.9.9.9

Slot DNS settings (nvram)
Each slot's DNS servers, as set in MANAGE or the web interface.
wgc1_dns=9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112  # wgc1:pia-aus_perth
wgc2_dns=9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112  # wgc2:pia-au_adelaide-pf
wgc3_dns=9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112  # wgc3:pia-au_brisbane-pf
wgc4_dns=  # not configured
wgc5_dns=9.9.9.9, 149.112.112.112  # wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne
